items.title: Live: The Classic 100 countdown has begun but who will be the Greatest of All Time?
items.description: Tens of thousands of Australians have cast their votes in the 2025 Classic 100: Greatest Of All Time. Join us as we count down to #1.

items.title: Missing Melbourne teacher allegedly murdered by brother in India
items.description: Indian authorities allege Melbourne maths teacher Sunil Sharma was murdered by his brother and dumped in a canal. He had been in India to prepare a property for sale.

items.title: Multiple people shot near Ohio festival, US authorities say
items.description: Multiple people have been shot near a festival in Ohio, authorities say.

items.title: 'Cybertongue' could prevent 70 million tonnes of milk waste every year
items.description: About a sixth of the world's milk is wasted, over 150 tonnes every year, but a Canberra company has come up with new technology that could drastically reduce that.

items.title: Marilyn's world 'fell apart' with one post. What happened next helped her heal
items.description: Marilyn was just five when she first encountered grief. Now 18, the teenager says she's been to more funerals than birthday parties.

items.title: Trump battles historians for ownership of US presidential records
items.description: The Trump administration is pushing for a return to pre-Nixon days when US presidents could do whatever they wanted with presidential records.

items.title: Debunking Australian weather's made-up terms and pseudoscience
items.description: Meteorological rhetoric in Australia, including from the media, can at times be inaccurate, misconstrued or just completely fictitious.

items.title: Psychologist sounds alarm over looksmaxxing and 'out-mogging'
items.description: While it's a bit of fun for some, the social media trend known as looksmaxxing can have major impacts on young men's physical and mental health.

items.title: This little girl got measles at five months old. She died from it 10 years later
items.description: Measles killed Rebecca Archer's daughter Renae slowly and silently over a decade. She has a message for the growing number of parents hesitant to have their children vaccinated.

items.title: Ukraine renews attacks on St Petersburg after Putin rejects Zelenskyy meeting
items.description: A large-scale Ukrainian drone attack targets St Petersburg, with Russia intercepting 376 drones.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
